note: Revolut design references under /samples. Kept out of navigation.json on purpose: that file is the source of truth for the real route tree and the catch-all generates every href in it, so a sample listed there would collide with its own page.tsx. Adding an entry here adds it to the header dropdown and the /samples index; the page itself lives at src/app/(samples)/samples/<slug>/page.tsx.
label: Sample Pages

items.label: Sample Page One
items.summary: Revolut Business — Bills. Hero video, card carousel, phone carousel, testimonial, FAQ.

items.label: Placeholder kit
items.summary: Every stand-in image and crop available to a sample page.

items.label: Apex Sections
items.summary: Apex Welcome as 22 components across 9 sections. Built on Welcome's own design system — v34 tokens plus welcome.css.

items.label: Welcome Page Two
items.summary: Second pass at Welcome, carrying the real site chrome. Thirty sections: video hero, WebGL particle field, post marquee and expanding product cards, then twenty-two lifted from Welcome and Apex Sections and four from Sample Page One.

items.label: Welcome · Mobile Options
items.summary: Three blocks of the live Welcome page, five mobile layouts each, plus five ways a Four Moments bento tile expands (Bento Expand): twenty labelled variations with a sticky jump menu, for review on a phone.

items.label: Welcome · Mobile Options 2
items.summary: Round 2 from the review: the hero and first VSL on their own (five each), What Works refined with a month calendar and an F1-style list, Four Moments with a highlight reel, and three Bento Expands including a true full-screen takeover.

items.label: Desktop Design Samples
items.summary: Five desktop layouts, each with its tablet version, for the spine header and the hero stage: the 9:16 executive VSL against Them vs Us. Classic Stack, Sticky Split, Bento, Triptych and Flip Toggle, with a sticky jump menu.

items.label: Desktop Design Samples 2
items.summary: Round 2: three tops with the film full bleed behind the headline and the VSL as one 9:16 card, and three bottoms with the revised Them vs Us pair (four NEVER SENT rows against four timed rows). Each with its tablet version.

items.label: Hero Data Cards
items.summary: The live Welcome hero three times, with only its three data cards redesigned on the APEX Way timeline rows (the figure in the time-label spot), each version in its own translucent treatment; the VSL shown as the bare film.

items.label: Wrong Way Headings
items.summary: The live Welcome page's Wrong Way vs APEX Way section with a mini heading on each side: over a smaller calendar on the Wrong Way, over the four rows on the APEX Way, each side's heading and content held to the phone's height.

items.label: Hero Cards Legibility
items.summary: The live Welcome hero three times, only its three cards' boxes changed so their copy reads at a glance: a ticker, a large statement and a poster stack, in the same colours and with only the copy already on the cards.

items.label: Welcome Swap Preview
items.summary: The live Welcome hero and the Wrong Way vs APEX Way section with the cards swapped (APEX Way left, Wrong Way right and mirrored) and the two phones trading screens: the briefing VSL in the Wrong Way phone, the reminder text in the hero.
